model_type: strategic allocation planning range — research-only product diligence, no point return forecast

conditional_reference_vector_after_indep.asset: eligible protected liquidity (named and passed product required)
511010 or separately passed duration-controlled sovereign exposure
510880 or separately passed dividend equity exposure
public REIT sleeve, only passed projects
defensive diversifier, named and passed product required

cash_measurement.objective: At least 3% cash available for reinvestment is a future rolling-twelve-month settled net-cash objective, not a product promise.
cash_measurement.net_cash_yield_formula: eligible settled cash receipts after withholding/transaction taxes, receipt fees, expected recurring implementation costs and documented distribution-cut haircuts divided by beginning portfolio capital; no receipt may be counted twice.
eligible_receipts: cash fund distributions when actually settled
REIT cash distributions when actually settled
excluded_receipts: return of principal unless legally verified and separately disclosed
cash_measurement.default_use: Reinvest only after the recipient product and the portfolio pass their own eligibility gates; otherwise retain in protected liquidity.
cash_measurement.failure_rule: A shortfall is recorded as a shortfall. It cannot be repaired by leverage, lower credit quality, forced REIT purchases, concentrated equity exposure or sale of principal labelled as income.

total_return_measurement.objective: At least 5% total return is a research objective, not an annual floor or forecast.
total_return_measurement.formula: TWRR is chain-linked across external-flow subperiods and includes price/NAV changes plus eligible cash distributions; investor MWRR/XIRR is separately calculated from actual dated cash flows.
total_return_measurement.reinvestment_rule: Cash distributions are part of total return once; reinvestment changes the next-period capital base and cannot create a second return entry.
total_return_measurement.failure_rule: No strategy return claim may be made without a reproducible point-in-time replay including historical constituents/projects, costs, taxes, liquidity/capacity assumptions and benchmark comparison.

cash_distribution_policy.actual_measure: No D0 is claimed in this product-due-diligence memo; periodic product cash data are historical observations only.

return_evidence.formal_test_requirement: Run an independent, point-in-time total-return and settled-net-cash replay only after the exact product set, rebalance method, tax/account assumptions and historical product data are available.
return_evidence.benchmark_requirement: Compare against protected liquidity, duration-matched sovereign exposure and relevant multi-asset alternatives; report drawdown, hit rate, capacity, turnover and cash shortfall frequency.

risk_budget.approval_requirement: Approve scenario stresses, factor correlations, drawdown actions, concentration caps, liquidity capacity and investor suitability before any nonzero market exposure.
risk_budget.loss_limit: No loss budget is approved. The reference framework uses a -12% caution review and -18% mandatory risk action only after a real, external-flow-adjusted portfolio series exists.

direct_high_dividend_stocks.current_model_treatment: excluded; direct equities are outside this product research universe

public_reits.inactive_behavior: Remain in protected liquidity until all product and portfolio gates pass.
public_reits.funding_source_on_activation: Only an independently approved portfolio allocation process; this memo provides none.
required_checks: project rights and current asset inventory

warnings: The protected-liquidity and defensive-diversifier categories are unnamed and cannot be assessed as products.
The conditional reference vector is not a current allocation, a recommendation or a return forecast.
